title: Закупка высокопроизводительного вычислительного кластера с GPU и серверной инфраструктурой для Инха Университет Ташкент
title_en: Procurement of High-Performance Computing Cluster with GPUs and Big Data Server Infrastructure for Inha University Tashkent
ai_digital_scope: Two AI compute clusters (1 MW total capacity): first cluster for education and scientific research at Inha University Tashkent, second cluster for digital government, healthcare, banking and industrial AI projects. GPU-based HPC with Nvidia partnership. Procurement deadline mandated as 1 June 2026 by УП-189.
win_probability_rationale: ICB format with foreign eligibility. Nvidia partnership announced (L2_VERIFIED) suggests pre-selected architecture but not necessarily pre-selected integrator. Export control negotiations with US government add uncertainty. CIS/Russian system integrators with Nvidia authorization are competitive.

title: Разработка и внедрение платформы электронного правосудия «Цифровой суд» с модулем ИИ-ассистента
title_en: Development and Implementation of Digital Court (E-Justice) Platform with AI Assistant Module
ai_digital_scope: Full digital court case management system. Scope: electronic case filing (my.sud.uz portal), AI-powered legal assistant module (launched Jan 2026), automated court session audio transcription, biometric identification in courtrooms, integration with EPIGU and MyID, e-notification for parties. Initial pilot in Tashkent courtrooms, national rollout 2026-2027.
win_probability_rationale: UNDP has prior e-SUD project engagement (court case management). Uzbek incumbent UZINFOCOM likely technical lead. Joint venture requirement opens door for foreign AI/NLP component supplier. Turkish Havelsan (digital judiciary reference) and CIS vendors are positioned. Window exists for AI module subcontract.

title: Расширение и модернизация цифровой медицинской информационной системы DMED с ИИ-модулями клинической поддержки принятия решений
title_en: Expansion and Modernization of DMED Digital Medical Information System with AI Clinical Decision Support Modules
ai_digital_scope: Phase 2 of DMED platform (UZINFOCOM-operated). Scope: AI-based clinical decision support module, speech-to-text for doctor notes (Uzbek/Russian), e-prescription anti-fraud analytics, FHIR HL7-compliant APIs, telemedicine integration, pilot in Almazar and Yunusabad districts of Tashkent. 9,986 computers and 8,220 tablets hardware rollout included.
win_probability_rationale: UZINFOCOM is the sitting integrator of DMED. Foreign firms best positioned as AI module sub-contractors under JV. Clinical NLP in Russian/Uzbek is a genuine differentiator. KOICA/WHO co-funding possible for training component. Spec written around FHIR/HL7 opens international participation.

sources.title: Uzbekistan enhances healthcare system with new digital prescription and mobile app features

title: Создание геопространственной инфраструктуры NSDI — услуги консультантов по компоненту A
title_en: Geospatial NSDI Infrastructure Implementation — Consulting Services Component A
ai_digital_scope: World Bank P506803 ($35M, 2025-2030). NSDI Action Plan implementation per UN-IGIF framework. AI-enhanced satellite imagery analysis for cadastral mapping, installation of 80 CORS stations (GPS reference), upgrade of national surveying and mapping systems, integration with EPIGU digital services. Component A: NSDI enabling environment and institutional setup.
win_probability_rationale: World Bank QCBS with donor rules — most transparent procurement modality in UZ. No prior NSDI integrator incumbent. Strong foreign eligibility. Geospatial + AI analytics is a distinctive niche. WB-mandated quality-based selection favors international specialists over local.

title: Разработка и обслуживание ИИ-чатбота для ЕПИГУ (EPIGU) на русском и узбекском языках
title_en: Development and Maintenance of AI Chatbot for EPIGU Citizen Services Portal (Russian/Uzbek bilingual)
ai_digital_scope: Conversational AI for EPIGU (720+ digital government services). Russian-Uzbek bilingual NLP, intent classification, FAQs automation, escalation to live agents, integration with MyID for authenticated queries. Agentic workflows for common citizen requests (passport, utilities, tax certificates). Scope may include voice interface.
win_probability_rationale: Russian-Uzbek NLP is a genuine competitive moat. No single incumbent dominates conversational AI in UZ government. JV requirement with local firm is manageable. UZEX already uses AI chatbot (different scope). High strategic value given УП-189 mandate to showcase AI in citizen services.

title: Создание системы обнаружения и предотвращения киберугроз (SOC) для государственной информационной инфраструктуры
title_en: Creation of Cyber Threat Detection and Prevention System (SOC) for State Information Infrastructure
ai_digital_scope: National cybersecurity SOC modernization under УП-38 (Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030). New cybersecurity units mandated across government agencies from 1 April 2026. Registry of authorized cybersecurity outsourcing providers established. SOC platform: SIEM/SOAR, AI threat analytics, incident response automation, national coordinating council integration.
win_probability_rationale: Local-only eligibility per cybersecurity law priority-of-domestic-producers clause (ЗРУ-764). UNICON.UZ is the state cybersecurity integrator and likely award recipient. Foreign firms can participate only as subcontractors or technology licensors. Best entry: technology partnership with UNICON.

sources.title: Uzbekistan adopts national cybersecurity strategy to 2030

title: Поставка 16 суперкомпьютеров для государственных министерств и ведомств
title_en: Supply of 16 Supercomputers for State Ministries and Agencies
ai_digital_scope: 16 supercomputer systems for distribution to key ministries. 2026 budget doubles from 2025's $50M allocation. Supports consolidation of 55 databases into single data center (2025) and integration of all databases (2026). AI workload processing for 100+ priority AI projects across healthcare, tax, customs, transport, agriculture.
win_probability_rationale: ICB format. Hardware supply is straightforward for Nvidia/HPE/Lenovo. Export controls from US on advanced GPU chips create risk. Nvidia partnership pre-announced (MoU level) suggests preferred vendor but integrator not confirmed. Chinese AI hardware vendors (Huawei Ascend) are strong alternative given export control uncertainty.

title: Обучение государственных служащих в области ИИ и цифровых технологий — платформа и проведение курсов
title_en: AI and Digital Skills Training for Civil Servants — Platform Development and Course Delivery
ai_digital_scope: Civil servant AI literacy training under УП-189 mandate. World Bank Digital Inclusion Project P179108 co-funding possible. Scope: LMS platform (Russian/Uzbek), AI fundamentals curriculum, prompt engineering, AI tools for government workflows, certifications. Target: all senior civil servants in priority ministries by end 2026.
win_probability_rationale: WB Digital Inclusion co-funding makes this donor_rules procurement. Skills training is the most open procurement category in UZ — no credible incumbent. Foreign providers with Russian-language curriculum and CIS government training experience have clear advantage. QCBS method is transparent.

title: Разработка и внедрение системы медицинского страхования — IT-платформа ОСМС
title_en: Development and Implementation of State Medical Insurance IT Platform (OSMS)
ai_digital_scope: National State Medical Insurance (OSMS) IT platform under ПП-311. Universal healthcare launched 2026. Platform: insurance registry, claims processing, fraud detection AI, provider network management, citizen self-service (EPIGU integration), payment gateway. Massive scale: entire population of 37M.
win_probability_rationale: New system with no incumbent. Government may prefer UZINFOCOM-led consortium. However, health insurance platform complexity and scale may require specialized international partner. KOICA (Korean health IT) or EU EBRD funding possible. JV requirement is achievable.

sources.title: Uzbekistan's New State Medical Insurance: Universal Healthcare Launch

title: Внедрение ИИ-системы для анализа рисков и обнаружения мошенничества в налоговых декларациях
title_en: AI Risk Analysis and Tax Fraud Detection System for State Tax Committee
ai_digital_scope: AI-based e-invoicing analytics and tax risk scoring. Automated flagging of high-risk transactions (transactions > 10% above/below AI-calculated market benchmark). March 2026 AI price module deployment. ML anomaly detection, cross-database taxpayer profiling, integration with customs data. Presidential decree mandated AI in procurement from March 2026.
win_probability_rationale: AI price module for procurement (from March 2026) represents a concrete existing mandate. Tax AI is politically sensitive but internationally well-precedented (Georgia, Baltics). Russian CIS vendors with prior GNK relationships (1C, InfoSoft) are incumbents. Foreign AI analytics firms need local JV. Window exists for ML layer.

title: Создание ИИ-лабораторий в 15 университетах Узбекистана
title_en: Establishment of AI Laboratories in 15 Uzbekistan Universities
ai_digital_scope: 15 university AI labs under УП-189 mandate. Equipment: GPU workstations, ML training clusters, robotics kits, IoT lab equipment, AR/VR sets. Software: licensed AI development environments, datasets, cloud credits. Curriculum development for AI courses at undergraduate level. AI textbook (MIT partnership) integration.
win_probability_rationale: ICB with foreign eligibility. Multiple lots likely (equipment + software + curriculum). No single incumbent for this new program. Korean (KOICA), UAE, and EU vendors are active in UZ university market. Strong case for comprehensive provider who can bundle hardware + curriculum + certification.

title: Разработка мобильного цифрового паспорта / Mobile-ID и интеграция с MyID
title_en: Mobile Digital Passport / Mobile-ID App Development and MyID Integration
ai_digital_scope: Mobile-ID rollout as digital complement to biometric ID card. MyID integration for legally valid digital authentication on mobile. NFC chip reading of ID card by smartphone, face biometrics verification, liveness detection AI. Integration with EPIGU (720+ services), banking sector, and legal document signing.
win_probability_rationale: UZINFOCOM is likely incumbent through MyID infrastructure. However biometric/liveness detection module is specialty and may be separately tendered. Estonian digital ID stack (X-Road/SK ID Solutions) is used as reference architecture. JV pathway viable for identity verification technology providers.

title: ИТ-парк Узбекистан: конкурс на разработку ИИ-продуктов для государственного сектора (AI Cluster грант)
title_en: IT Park Uzbekistan AI Cluster Grant Competition for AI Product Development for Government Sector
ai_digital_scope: $1M prize fund for Best AI Startup competition (ПП-320 framework). AI Cluster at New Uzbekistan University also issuing grants for AI projects in government applications. Sectors: healthcare AI, legal AI, agricultural AI, digital government AI. Grant size $100K-$500K per project.
win_probability_rationale: Open competition format. IT Park Uzbekistan welcomes foreign resident companies. Grant-based (not procurement) mechanism means no incumbent advantage. Russian, Korean, UAE startup ecosystem active in Tashkent. Best entry path for smaller firms to establish presence before larger tenders.

title: Внедрение цифровых технологий в сельское хозяйство — ИИ-мониторинг полей, спутниковый анализ
title_en: Digital Agriculture Technologies — AI Field Monitoring and Satellite Imagery Analysis Platform
ai_digital_scope: ПП-99 (March 2025) digital agriculture program. AI satellite imagery for cotton and wheat field monitoring, yield prediction, irrigation optimization, pest detection. Integration with government agricultural registry. Drone survey component. IoT soil sensors network in Ferghana Valley pilot region.
win_probability_rationale: QCBS with foreign eligibility. No established incumbent in precision agriculture AI in UZ. Donor co-funding likely (WB agriculture component, JICA smart logistics overlap). Russian remote sensing companies (Roscosmos commercial arm) are potential competitors. Unique opportunity for specialized AgriTech AI firms.

title: Разработка Государственной цифровой платформы управления данными (Data.gov.uz) с ИИ-аналитикой открытых данных
title_en: Development of State Open Data Platform (Data.gov.uz) with AI-Powered Open Data Analytics
ai_digital_scope: Open data platform expansion and AI analytics layer. Data.gov.uz existing portal upgrade: API standardization, machine-readable dataset publication, AI-powered dataset discovery, natural language query interface, government data interoperability with EPIGU. World Bank Digital Inclusion P179108 co-funding component.
win_probability_rationale: QCBS with WB rules = transparent procurement. Open data platforms are non-sensitive and foreign-accessible. No strong incumbent. Civitta (Baltic advisory firm) already has a UZ MoH engagement reference. Open-source GovTech vendors (CKAN-based) have natural advantage.
